subject: FinApp inbound — quick fit questions + 3 slot options for demo
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@finapp.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 08:50:00 -0400
Subject: Interested in Redwood demo and trial (FinApp)

Hi Priya,

We signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday and I’m interested in a short demo to see how Redwood would fit into our in-app assistant and search use cases. A couple quick details that matter to us:

- Primary use case: embeddings for search + a chat assistant for customer support and product guidance.
- Monthly token estimate: ~1.8M tokens/month currently, with weekly spikes that can be 3–4x.
- Timeline: want a POC within the next 3–4 weeks and go to production in Q4 if perf and cost look good.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is a requirement for vendor approval; we’ll need to know what evidence you can provide.

Can you share availability for a 30-minute demo next week? Prefer mornings ET. Happy to include our infra lead if you want to talk network/VPC options.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Platform, FinApp
samir@finapp.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finapp.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo and trial (FinApp)

Hi Samir — thanks for signing up and for the context. I work with new inbound accounts and can set up a short demo and introduce Ben (AE) if that works. A couple quick fit questions so we make the session high signal: 

1) Confirm the two primary goals for the POC (embedding search quality vs. assistant latency/cost tradeoffs) — which is highest priority?
2) Do you have any hard SLAs or 95th/99th percentile latency targets for your live users?
3) For the token volumes you quoted, are those token counts for generations only or do they include embedding index/ingest tokens?
4) Any regulatory constraints besides SOC 2 (e.g., data residency, HIPAA, CCPA)?

Proposed 30-minute slots (all ET):
- Tue Jul 20, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 21, 09:00–09:30
- Thu Jul 22, 11:00–11:30

Or feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/priya-30m. If you want Ben to lead the demo, I’ll loop him in and send the deck in advance.

If you can attach a quick traffic/volume export (CSV) that shows spike patterns, that’ll help us pick the right model/config for the demo.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
SDR, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
From: Samir Shah <samir@finapp.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: integration@finapp.ai
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo and trial (FinApp)

Hi Priya — thanks for the fast reply. Answers below and I attached a small CSV with daily token counts for the last 30 days.

1) Priority = embedding search relevance first, assistant second. We need search relevance to be near parity with our current vendor.
2) No contractual SLA yet; internal goal is <200ms p95 for short chat responses (under 200 tokens) and <300ms p95 for embedding retrieval pipelines.
3) The 1.8M figure includes both generation and embedding ingest; embeddings account for roughly 40% of tokens.
4) SOC 2 Type II required. No HIPAA. Data residency: US-only for now.

Preferred times: Wed Jul 21 at 09:00 ET or Thu Jul 22 at 11:00 ET both work for our team. Attendees: me (Platform), Anika Rao (infra lead), and Rohan Mehta (product). I’ve copied our integration mailbox for calendar invites.

Attached: traffic_estimates.csv

—Samir
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finapp.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood demo and trial (FinApp)

Hi Samir — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the clarity on priorities and the CSV — that helps a lot. I’m available Wed Jul 21 at 09:00 ET and will run a focused 30-minute session that covers: 

- Short intro + POC goals (5 min)
- Embedding indexing and retrieval demo with sample queries (12 min)
- Assistant latency/cost knobs and recommended config for your volumes (8 min)
- Next steps: POC scope and timeline (5 min)

I’ve attached a short demo deck so you know what we’ll cover: redwood_demo-deck.pdf.

Please confirm the Wed 09:00 ET slot and I’ll send a calendar invite to integration@finapp.ai and include Anika/Rohan. If you prefer, we can also add a short pre-call with your infra lead to review VPC/network configuration — let me know.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132
